data.readme:
1. 修复 Xbox 主机休眠后唤醒时手柄异常的问题。
2. 修复连接 3.5mm 耳机时麦克风有噪声的问题。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed the abnormal issue of the controller when waking up the Xbox console from sleep mode.
2. Fixed the issue of microphone noise when connecting with a 3.5mm headset.

data.readme_en: 1. Fixed the issue where some Windows devices cannot properly recognize the controller via wired USB connection.
